claim_1.claim: Bulk RNA-seq analysis of whole blood from 18 healthy rVSV-ZEBOV vaccine recipients on days 0, 1, 3, and 7 after vaccination showed that the strongest transcriptional response occurred on day 1, with 10,123 genes significantly differentially expressed compared with day 0; among the day 1 genes with the largest fold changes was CXCL10, the gene encoding IP-10.

sources.quote: Differential gene expression from the day 0 baseline was investigated gene-wise using the voom/limma method. The highest number of differentially expressed genes was observed on day 1 after vaccination, with 10,123 genes being significantly differentially expressed compared with day 0.
Among the 10,123 differentially expressed genes on day 1 overall (both dose groups combined), the 10 genes with the largest fold changes included CXCL10, the gene encoding for IP-10.

comparison.finding: Day 1 showed the highest number of significantly differentially expressed genes compared with day 0, with 10,123 genes differentially expressed; CXCL10, encoding IP-10, was among the 10 genes with the largest fold changes.
Day 3 was analyzed as a post-vaccination timepoint compared with day 0 baseline.The highest number of differentially expressed genes occurred on day 1.
Day 7 was analyzed as a post-vaccination timepoint compared with day 0 baseline. The day 7 vs day 0 comparison showed fewer differentially expressed genes as compared to day 1.
